parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: ScanType
parameters.description:
The type of the vulnerability. Valid values:

*   `VUL`: Products Cloud Security Scanner.
*   `SBOM`: Product Content Analysis.

Default value: `VUL`

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr list-scan-rule --instance-id cri-upoulewerx00000 --page-no 1 --page-size 30 --scan-type SBOM --region cn-hangzhou
